headline: The government decided on Tuesday to bar vehicles without fitness and emission testing from entering Islamabad to curb smog and air pollution, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Smog kam karne ke liye hukoomat ne Tuesday ko faisla kiya.

caption:
Fitness aur emission test ke baghair gaariyan ab Islamabad mein dakhil nahi ho sakengi! 🚗
Dawn ke mutabiq hukoomat ne Tuesday ko smog aur fazai aloodgi kam karne ke liye yeh faisla kiya. Yeh faisla Minister of State for Interior Tallal Chaudhry ki sadarat mein hone wale ijlas mein hua. Ijlas mein yeh bhi tay hua ke khule mein aag jalane walon par bhari jurmane honge. Pak-EPA ke mutabiq October 2026 mein Islamabad ka average AQI 148 raha, jabke October 2025 mein yeh 169 tha. Tallal Chaudhry ne kaha ke dhuan chhorne wale bhatton aur karkhanon ke khilaf bhi sakht karwai hogi.
Kya yeh faisla smog kam karne mein madadgar hoga? Comment mein batayein 👇
